chapters.title: Why contact centers feel like firefighting
AI buffs agents, not replaces them

takeaways: Sentiment analysis in Dynamics 365 Contact Center reads tone, phrasing and pacing to route frustrated or high-value customers to the right agent sooner.
Case management, customer intent and knowledge management agents take over repetitive casework, ideally starting in supervised assist mode.
Copilot summaries, Ask a question and drafted replies keep context intact so customers do not have to repeat themselves.
hook: Contact center teams lose customers and staff when every interaction starts from scratch and urgent cases wait in line. This episode shows service leaders how sentiment-based routing, AI agents and Copilot in Dynamics 365 move a contact center from firefighting to proactive, context-rich engagement.
